title: Item:Elixir of Hidden Potential
wikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{Top}}
[[File:Sovereign Elixir of Hidden Potential effect.png|thumb|right|Buff bar effect text]]
Consuming Elixir of Hidden Potential increases your chance of finding a fourth affix on random loot.

The effect lasts for 1 to 6 hours depending on elixir consumed. The timer pauses while in public area or logged out.

Elixir of Hidden Potential are bound to account.

{{Unverified|It seems that the base chance of the extra affix is 3 percent,}} and a sovereign elixir quadruples the chance to 3+9 = 12 percent.

Elixir of Hidden Potential can be acquired from [[DDO Store]].
